usage.checkInSuccess: duration.slow + easing.springSubtle, single scale pulse 1→1.03→1, no confetti

rules: No animation longer than 320ms in product UI.
No parallax, no auto-playing carousels, no bouncing attention-seekers.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: replace all transforms with opacity-only changes and disable skeleton shimmer (use a static tint).
Never animate a number counting up in payroll or attendance — figures appear at final value.
Loading spinners only after 400ms of waiting; below that, no indicator.
